name: Matsubara Yuuna
source:
A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average [url=/c5721]Nanami[/url]. 

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sono_Hanabira_ni_Kuchizuke_o]Wikipedia[/url]]
